cohort: 1473 liveborn infants with a birth weight <= 500g and gestational age >= 22 weeks treated in Japanese hospitals between 2003 and 2012
finding: While survival to hospital discharge improved for infants with a birth weight <= 500g over the 10-year study period, the rate of at least one severe morbidity among survivors remained high (81-89%).
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with increased survival to discharge in infants with a birth weight <= 500g.
